statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a UAS does not understand an option-tag listed in a Require header field, it MUST respond by generating a response with status code 420 (Bad Extension).
actions: Generate response with status code 420 (Bad Extension)

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The UAS MUST add an Unsupported header field, and list in it those options it does not understand amongst those in the Require header field of the request.
actions: Add Unsupported header field to 420 response
List in Unsupported header all option-tags from Require not understood by UAS

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Note that Require and Proxy-Require MUST NOT be used in a SIP CANCEL request, or in an ACK request sent for a non-2xx response.
actions: Omit Require header field from CANCEL request
Omit Proxy-Require header field from CANCEL request
Omit Require header field from ACK for non-2xx response
Omit Proxy-Require header field from ACK for non-2xx response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: These header fields MUST be ignored if they are present in these requests.
statements.pre_cond: (message.method = CANCEL | (message.method = ACK & message.correlated_response_code != 2xx)) & (message.Require.present = true | message.Proxy-Require.present = true)
actions: Ignore Require header field when present in CANCEL request
Ignore Proxy-Require header field when present in CANCEL request
Ignore Require header field when present in ACK for non-2xx response
Ignore Proxy-Require header field when present in ACK for non-2xx response

statements.subject: client
statements.description: An ACK request for a 2xx response MUST contain only those Require and Proxy-Require values that were present in the initial request.
actions: Include in ACK Require values only those present in the initial request
Include in ACK Proxy-Require values only those present in the initial request
